People.Heading: The people behind Architage
People.Tagline: Building with experience. Creating with passion. Preserving our heritage.
People.Description: Architage India Private Limited is driven by a shared vision to bring traditional architecture back into contemporary living. Founded on a passion for heritage homes and meaningful construction, the company brings together architectural expertise, industry experience and business vision.
People.Belief: Our founders share a common belief that a home is more than just a structure. It is a reflection of culture, identity, craftsmanship and generations of memories.

Founders.Name: Subin Pangil
Founders.Tagline: Preserving Architectural Heritage. Creating Timeless Living Spaces.
Highlights: Architecture graduate, Dr. C. V. Raman University
Bio: Subin Pangil is the Founder of Architage India Private Limited, an architecture and construction professional with over 12 years of experience in the construction and architectural field. An architecture graduate from Dr. C. V. Raman University, he has developed a deep understanding of traditional Kerala architecture, Vastu Shastra, and the science behind traditional building practices.

Currently pursuing advanced academic studies in Vastu and traditional architecture, he is also pursuing PhD-level research focused on traditional Kerala architectural practices. His areas of academic interest include the architectural principles of Nalukettu, Mana, Illam and Tharavadu homes, traditional construction measurements, Thachu Shastra, climatic responsiveness, and the relationship between architectural design and natural living.

Sections.Heading: Architectural Expertise & Experience
Paragraphs: Subin has a particular passion for rediscovering traditional Kerala homes and understanding the architectural intelligence behind their construction. Through extensive travel, observation, and practical study, he has explored numerous heritage properties, documenting their structural patterns, traditional measurements, roof slopes, foundation systems, wooden craftsmanship, and spatial arrangements.
He strongly believes that traditional homes were designed with a remarkable understanding of natural ventilation, air circulation, sunlight, climatic conditions, and the principles of Vastu.

One of his notable achievements is the successful transformation of more than 10 traditional Illams and Nalukettu-style houses into homes equipped with modern facilities while retaining their original traditional appearance and architectural character.

His approach goes beyond visual restoration. He studies the original architectural proportions, structural arrangements, roof measurements, foundation principles, and traditional construction techniques to understand how these elements can be incorporated into contemporary construction.

Sections.Heading: Vision & Architectural Philosophy
Paragraphs: Subin's architectural philosophy is built around one fundamental belief: Traditional architecture should evolve with time, not disappear with time.
He envisions a future where families can enjoy the comfort and technology of modern homes while experiencing the beauty, cultural identity, and functional wisdom of traditional architecture.

Points.Title: Heritage Preservation
Points.Description: Retaining the character and architectural identity of traditional Illams, Nalukettu homes, and other heritage structures.

Points.Title: Modern Adaptation
Points.Description: Integrating contemporary amenities and modern interior facilities without compromising traditional exterior aesthetics.

Points.Title: Vastu & Natural Living
Points.Description: Applying traditional architectural principles with attention to ventilation, air circulation, sunlight, and climatic comfort.

Points.Title: Traditional Construction Knowledge
Points.Description: Studying and applying authentic proportions, roof slopes, foundation measurements, and construction techniques.

Points.Title: Research-Driven Design
Points.Description: Learning from existing heritage buildings and translating their architectural wisdom into new construction.

Sections.Heading: His Vision for Architage
Paragraphs: Through Architage India Private Limited, Subin aims to bring the timeless beauty of traditional Indian architecture into modern homes.
His mission is to revive the architectural intelligence of our ancestors and transform it into practical, sustainable, and comfortable living spaces for today's generations.
For him, every traditional home carries a story, a science, and a cultural identity. His ambition is to preserve that legacy through thoughtful architectural design and quality construction.

Founders.Quote: We don't simply recreate traditional homes; we rediscover the wisdom behind them and bring that timeless architecture into modern living.

Founders.Name: Adarsh T
Founders.Tagline: Blending Financial Expertise with a Passion for Heritage Architecture
Highlights: 8 years in banking and financial management
Bio: Adarsh T is the Founder of Architage India Private Limited, bringing together eight years of professional experience in banking and financial management with a deep-rooted passion for traditional Indian architecture, heritage homes, and cultural living.

An MBA graduate from Acharya Bangalore B-School, Adarsh has developed strong expertise in financial management, cost planning, and financial strategy. His professional background provides a valuable foundation for managing construction costs, financial planning, and delivering quality projects with a practical and sustainable approach.

Beyond finance, his passion lies in rediscovering India's architectural heritage. Driven by a long-standing interest in traditional homes and the joint-family way of living, he has extensively explored and studied the architectural traditions of both South and North India. His interests include the magnificent Chettinad mansions, the traditional Kerala Nalukettu, and other regional architectural styles that reflect India's cultural richness.

Sections.Heading: Vision & Architectural Philosophy
Paragraphs: Adarsh strongly believes that traditional homes are more than architectural structures; they represent family bonds, cultural identity, generations of memories, and a way of life that deserves to be preserved.
His vision is to bring traditional architecture into modern living by thoughtfully combining heritage aesthetics, traditional craftsmanship, recycled materials, and contemporary comfort.

One of his distinctive initiatives is creating an experiential model home that presents the grandeur of a traditional Nalukettu exterior alongside sophisticated, modern interiors, allowing customers to experience how heritage architecture can be adapted to today's lifestyle.

He is particularly passionate about exploring sustainable construction methods and the creative reuse of traditional and recycled materials to recreate the character and authenticity of heritage homes.

Sections.Heading: His Vision for Architage
Paragraphs: Through Architage India Private Limited, Adarsh aims to redefine the way people experience traditional homes — preserving the architectural identity of the past while embracing the conveniences of modern living.

Founders.Quote: We should not just build houses that look traditional; we should create homes that preserve the traditions, values, and lifestyle behind them.

Members.Name: Rajeswari
Bio: Rajeswari is the Director of Architage. With an MBA and 7 years of experience in finance and project management, she brings the discipline of numbers and schedules to something deeply personal: building a family's home.

That background shapes how Architage works: clear fixed prices, payments tied to completed stages, and projects planned before the first brick is laid. Families always know what they are paying for and what comes next.

Rajeswari has a lasting love for traditional Kerala houses. She believes homes hold memories, and that each corner is crafted by someone who cares. That belief guides every home Architage designs and builds: a home a family can live in, and hand down.

Her academic background, combined with her involvement in business, gives her a balanced perspective on management, innovation and business development. She also has a keen interest in traditional houses and heritage architecture, appreciating their timeless beauty, cultural values and unique design elements.

As a Director of ARCHITAGE, she aims to contribute to the company's growth through effective planning, teamwork and business development. She believes in building a company that values quality, trust and customer satisfaction.

Her vision is to support a business that combines creativity, quality and sustainability while preserving the charm of traditional architecture and creating lasting value for its clients and communities.

Vision.Heading: Our shared vision
Vision.Quote: Tradition is not just something we preserve; it is something we bring to life.
Vision.Description: At Architage, we envision creating homes that honour the architectural richness of Kerala while embracing the comfort and expectations of modern living. Every project is an opportunity to preserve a legacy, celebrate craftsmanship and create spaces that stand the test of time.
